emotionalArc: Frozen and unheard → stress and self-doubt → frustration as others win → discovery of the ebook → confident transformation → download CTA.

transition.description: Young man in a meeting, all eyes on him, he opens his mouth but no words come. Close-up, slow zoom. White flash transition.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Confront the viewer with being unable to express good ideas.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Good ideas but can't express them?

scenes.script: Tu as de bonnes idées mais tu n'arrives jamais à les exprimer ?

scenes.sceneName: LE PROBLÈME — TU PERDS TES MOYENS

transition.description: Fast montage: nervous eyes, trembling hands, hesitation, awkward silence. Close-ups, slight slow-mo. Quick fade.

scenes.script: Tu sais quoi dire, mais dès que plusieurs personnes te regardent, tu stresses, tu hésites et tu perds tes moyens.

transition.description: Someone else speaks confidently, people nod; main character stays silent, regretful. Shot/reverse, zoom on frustrated face. Whoosh.

scenes.script: Résultat ? Tes idées passent inaperçues et d'autres prennent les opportunités à ta place.

transition.description: Smartphone shows the ebook cover; 3D book animation, pages flip; icons: Confiance, Éloquence, Persuasion, Prise de parole. Light glow.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Introduce the ebook as the solution.

scenes.script: Avec le guide, L'Art de Bien Parler, maîtriser l'éloquence, tu apprends à parler avec assurance, captiver ton public et convaincre efficacement.

transition.description: Same character now standing before a group, confident smile, assured gestures, attentive audience. Forward travelling, hero shot. Zoom to ebook.

scenes.script: Même si aujourd'hui tu es timide ou que tu manques de confiance et que tu n'arrives pas à t'exprimer.

transition.description: Ebook cover full screen, premium light bg, animated arrow to pulsing button; brand logo; Acheter Maintenant; fade to black.

scenes.script: Télécharge ton ibouk maintenant et commence ta transformation aujourd'hui.
